final: WITH district_clients AS (SELECT a.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT disp.client_id) AS client_count FROM account AS a JOIN disp ON disp.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.district_id) SELECT district.A3 AS region, AVG(district_clients.client_count) AS avg_clients_per_district, AVG(district_clients.client_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client)) AS avg_share_of_all_clients FROM district_clients JOIN district ON district.district_id = district_clients.district_id GROUP BY district.A3
